_comment: T1 scroll-counter budget (Scripts/perf-scroll-counters.sh, compared by Scripts/perf_scroll_counters.py compare). counts: trials.csv columns that must stay within count_tolerance_pct of the base arm (per column: count_tolerance_pct_by_column), or within count_abs_slack (per column, else default) when that is larger. Idle budgets apply to the candidate (a base over budget too is reported as a WARN); idle instructions are per second of the measured idle window. scroll_instructions only warns: in the app they move with how many frames the host let it render. Calibration: see calibration.
calibration: 2026-11-19, adf-perf2-probe (iPhone 17 Pro, iOS 26.3.1), 6,000 pt/s, Release; 48 trials (3 A/A runs with one binary in both arms, plus main vs the T1 working tree; 8 per fixture x renderer) on a busy shared host (1-min load 4-27). Counts identical in every trial except: row_appears/row_disappears +-1 row (kitchen-sink and stress-1k); tk2_layouts/draws/conversions +-1 on stress-1k textkit2 (< 0.1 %); scroll_tk2_size_that_fits / scroll_tk2_infinite_width up to 2.1 % (list-dense textkit2: SwiftUI re-proposals follow frame timing). Idle: max 2.68 M instr/s (median 0.74 M); idle row churn, TK2 layouts and TK2 size queries 0 in every trial. Budget 8 M/s = 3x the observed max. Replays: a per-frame layout-feedback loop armed after the scroll idles at 30-32 M instr/s (FAIL); the same loop from launch saturates the main thread and never finishes the scroll (timeout = FAIL). Scroll instructions spread up to 7.2 % on kitchen-sink (a 0.5 s scroll), < 1.1 % on list-dense and stress-1k.
